Based on InverseAug and LearnableAlign, we develop a family of generic multi-modal 3D detection models named DeepFusion, which is more accurate than previous methods.

Our method fuses two modalities on deep feature level, while previous state-of-the-art methods (PointPainting [34] and PointAugmenting [36] as examples) decorate lidar points with camera features on input level.
